Subsidy-application exports for the Datenimport page (source "Antragsdaten"), from the test data
of the MIT-licensed [harmonie](https://github.com/agvolution/harmonie) library (demo farms).

- `DE-BY/` – iBALIS FlächenAbfrage: 2 Feldstücke
- `DE-NW/` – ELAN XML with the parcels and GML with the geometries: 1 Teilschlag
